# Country / Domain Intelligence Slice

Problem: An analyst or agent needs country-level comparative data with sources, freshness, evidence states and reconciliation warnings rather than an opaque ranking.
Pricing: Raven contains a country-brief pricing hypothesis ($299-$2,500 depending depth). No approved fixed machine price/payment path was verified, so it is not auto-quotable.

Machine state: discovery_only

Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- compare these countries on this metric
- give me sourced country intelligence
- which countries lead on this domain and why
- show me the evidence behind this country score
- reconcile conflicting country data
- country benchmark with sources

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
